verdict.rationale: Stark Bank is a banking API, so check issuance and check deposit are a fair question for this kind of product. Its documented money-movement rails are Pix, Boletos, TED transfers, cards, and utility and tax payments, and nothing in the evidence mentions paper checks, check issuance, or check deposit with image capture.

support.subject: As an ops user, checks still work — programmatic check issuance and check deposit with image capture, because real businesses still receive and send paper
